notes.title: 1.1.4 balance update is live!
notes.content:
Hello, agents!
 
How are those runs going? We hope you have reached security level 10 and given hell to INFINITY!

We've released a new update to fix some bugs and balance agents J4X and K31!

Read the patch notes for more details, and feel free to join our Official Discord server if you have any feedback or questions! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/f369e1a437756fbaed0f661c3dc94547f252e378.png

Fixed J4X hitting himself with Clinch
Fixed Achievements received in Tutorial
Fixed Mission Impossible Achievement
J4X Balance Changes
One Two: Changed from multi-target to single-target
Dempsey Roll: Increased energy cost and damage of basic version; upgraded version is unchanged
Dethrone: Increased energy cost from 1 to 2
Damage increased by 33%
Heal effect changed to fixed value, equal to base damage
Meteoric Punch: 
Increased Damage by 50%
Replaced “Hold” with “Apply 2 Stun (3 upgraded). Consume”
Taunt: Reduced combo requirement of basic version from 5 to 4; reduced draw to 1
K31 Balance Changes
Love and Peace: Added Consume
Guns Blazing: Energy cost increased by 1
Kneecap:
Changed from Melee to Ranged
Changed from multi-target to single-target
Lock and Load: 
Increased basic card energy cost to 2
Removed draw effect
Powder Monkey
Reduced basic card energy cost to 3
Reduced upgraded energy cost to 1
Removed Cost Down
Added Consume
Jungle Style: Removed Consume
Reassess: Added Consume
Cannibalise: Added Consume
Cargo Pants:
Increased basic card energy cost from 1 to 2
Reduced upgraded draw effect from 2 to 1

notes.title: 1.1.3 Hotfix update
notes.content:

We have just released another hotfix update for Nitro Kid! 

Find the patch notes below 👇

The following changes have been implemented in-game:


 Fixed Mission Impossible Achievement

notes.title: 1.1.1 Hotfix update
notes.content:
Hello, agents! 

We are happy to share that we have recently (November 12) implemented a new hotfix patch!

Find the patch notes below 👇

notes.title: 1.1.0 update is now live!
notes.content:
Hello, agents!
 
How are you? We hope you are teaching INFINITY security forces a lesson! 💪 

We're excited to share that we've updated the game with new difficulty modes, unique agent buffs, and other improvements!

Read the patch notes for more details, and feel free to join our Official Discord server if you have any feedback or questions! More updates coming soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/ab4914adfa2ac8de54f9df5c94c7e81d322329dc.png

New features and balance:
New difficulty modes: 
Simulation: Heal 30 HP at crystals, start with an Avatar Patch giving +1 Energy, basic cards are already upgraded, start with $200
Reality: Heal 30 HP at crystals. 25% bonus score and experience
Security 0: Heal 20 HP at crystals. Increased enemy damage and HP, Removing a card and upgrading a patch costs $25 more. 50% bonus to score and experience
Temporary and unique Player Buffs now show in the Player Buff UI 
L33: Maximum Effort and  Recursive Method. 
J4X: Underdog, Square Up, Paw, Magic Mitts, Ego Boost, Divine Fists
Infusion: Aluminium
Small improvements to the Codex and Unlock Intel UI 
Show version number, seed and difficulty in-game
Show Hero Patch in hero selection, and make loadout minis hoverable
Added deck count UI
Removed Beelzebub from the normal Patch pool (it needs a design rework)
Redesigned Commander Boss
Reduced the Brain enemies’ Shield gain from 3 to 2
Slightly reduced the following enemies’ HP values:
Business Act: All normal enemies, The Scientist, and The Fire Warden
Mech Act: Battle Mech, Buff Bot, Tackle Bot, Flame Bot, Auto Gunner, Technician, Shield Turret
Slightly reduced the following enemies’ Damage values:
Business Act: Shotgun Yuppie, The Fire Warden, The Founder
Mech Act: Battle Mech, Pursuit Bot, Tackle Bot, The Test Subject, The Broodmother
Experiment Act: Cadet, Aberration, Prodigy, Poacher, Radiation Bot.
Increased the damage of The Vine Queen and her Shrubs slightly.
Increased The Vine Queen’s strength gain on Bug Card played from 2 to 4.
K31 Balance Changes:
Small Bore - Increased Chamber value by 1
Bullet Witch - Changed effect text from “Whenever you Chamber while at max Ammo, Gain 1 Strength.” to “Whenever you Chamber beyond your max Ammo, Gain 1 Strength.”
Opening Shot - Reduced Damage from 5 to 4
L33 Balance Changes:
Death Strike - Reduced Energy cost from 2 to 1
Firestorm - Increased Energy cost from 1 to 3, increased effects by ~300%
Discombobulate - Increased Damage by ~50%
Replaced 1 Block Card from L33’s starting deck 
Added a new Card “Qi Pulse” to L33’s starting deck
+30 XP after every run
Bug fixes:
Fixed Bibliophile Achievement being stuck on 19/22
Reduced Saviour Achievement Kid's saved goal from 1000 to 250 
Backup system for safe files in case of file corruption
Fixed Twins boss soft lock issue
Fixed burn damage on Dragon Punch+ and Erupt+
Fixed bug when selecting cards for Upgrade, Remove, and Tutors (Assassin, Stoke the Fire, etc.) in very large decks
Boomtouch doesn't apply to Plutonium anymore
Cockroach now can't be removed in Events
K31's Tech Expert Patch now can't upgrade Tactical Reload
Fixed Copper Infusion + Cost Up Cards 
Cost reduction effects aren't given to cloned cards
Fix Ambush Event lock for when Player enters with 1 HP
J4X’s Power Drain card now affects Strength from Golden Glove correctly
Maximum Effort + Push Kick now targets correctly
The Hornet’s Damage on Card play is no longer increased by Security levels.
And many more minor bug fixes.

Thank you all for all the feedback, bug reports, and support! See you around! 💪👊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/ce9a7bad48c6a33a61ae2d94614879436222ca45.png

notes.content:
Hello agents! 👋

We hope you have been enjoying the game whilst listening to the original synthwave soundtrack! 🎶

We’ve recently revealed the complete list of music producers, and you can now listen to the soundtrack directly from your favorite music streaming platforms! 🎧

Full song list

Download it directly on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2182730/Nitro_Kid_Complete_Soundtrack/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/46d56e3fbb62f5b168bdfec7a1755f564cf6783f.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/7023986c8b2dbd7b56cb5ea6ff94a90a4267fad1.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/252186d52a6393013d35f7c17d94d88c2c602f60.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/59ac9dfef63fe8d11a309c2901c196a96a02adb4.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/af6f81e5776c4a496309bb9f979aa92a76c8967c.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/2385ec68c5651c10e7b370b8e8fb9a75bc41a169.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/aae12547060672582d908283444c6b9d766013ef.png
We are incredibly proud to have worked with LudoWic, Tonebox, Jules Reves, and Laird Kruger to create the Nitro Kid Original Soundtrack! Don’t hesitate to follow them on their artist channels for more awesome songs. 

🎘 Thijs Lodewijk, known as LudoWic, is an artist and musician based in the Netherlands. He works in the transitional area of music, art, and design, where he experiments with modern technology combining old vintage techniques and gear. He also worked on the Katana Zero's OST.
Check out LudoWic's Nitro Kid OST page Visit Ludowic.com

🎘 Jonas Pinnau, also known as Tonebox, is a DJ, mixing engineer, and synth programmer based in the US. His project blends influences of the 70s and 80s, synthwave, chiptune, ambient, and electro-house.
Check out Tonebox's Nitro Kid OST page Visit Toneboxmusic.com

🎘 Jules Reves is an electronic music artist who crafts futuristic soundscapes that combine 80s nostalgia with modern electronic genres. Based in Merano, Italy, his ambitions go beyond creating standard tracks, songs, and soundscapes the listener can be passionate about.
Check out Jules Reves' Nitro Kid OST page Visit Jules Reves's Linktr.ee for more info

🎘 Laird Kruger is a New Zealand based composer and multi-instrumentalist. His compositions range from the ambient to the hardcore, with the aim always to capture distinct cinematic and introspective moments. He is the creator of the Shimmer song that you probably have heard at the beginning of the game!
Visit LairdKruger.com for more info

Get the whole game and the OST, and listen to the awesome tunes even if you’re not playing the game! Check out our Turbo Bundle now!

We are also planning on creating a Discord radio channel on our Nitro Kid Discord server, and we will share more news about the Original Soundtrack soon. Follow the game to stay tuned!

notes.title: Get ready for Nitro Kid’s release on October 18th and join the playtest!
notes.content:
That's right, agents, get ready for some burning news! 

We're excited to announce that Nitro Kid will be released on October 18th! 
For those of you who are keen to play Nitro Kid sooner, you’re in luck! We're giving you a chance to play the game early with an exclusive pre-release playtest starting today! 

[previewyoutube=QsAubYOWvO8;full][/previewyoutube]  

How to apply
To sign up for the playtest, press the ‘Request Access’ on the game’s page. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/b66ddabad3e0fb1fe9545f431a9ef57e4f153546.gif

What’s inside?
When you get access to the playtest, you will be randomly assigned with one of the new agents. The playtest also features two floors, new room structure, new music and much more!

Meet your new playtest partners: J4X and K31

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/e50409fe084d1586e17b99c13f788c52d3fd65b7.png[/th]
    [td]J4X is a heavy-hitter who thinks like a chess player. He has a unique ability to counter-attack during the enemy turn. You can also build up Combo and Pressure points for devastating knock-outs![/td][/tr]
    [tr][th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42518135/86d33ab241d25840a24b2ab6b51eb5f98c369502.png[/th]
        [td]K31 is a glass cannon fighter, a tech and weaponry expert. She can switch between two different stances for ranged and close combat. Each stance comes with unique perks and limitations. You also should consider your ammo type and count (another character specific mechanic).[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Share your feedback with us
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you for the demo feedback you provided to us so far. We have taken it into consideration and the game has changed a lot because of it. We encourage you to join the playtest and share your experience with the new agents. 

We created two new discord channels for sharing your insights: #playtest-J4X and #playtest-K31. If you haven't joined our Official Discord server yet, please follow this invitation link to do so!

Recap:
Nitro Kid full game will be released on October 18th 
Request access to the exclusive pre-release playtest now 
Try one of the new agents - J4X or K31 - and share your experience with the community and the development team on  Discord!

notes.title: Announcing Nitro Kid — Play the Demo Now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1709050/

Watch the Announcement Trailer
[previewyoutube=Tu09NKNgSxk;full][/previewyoutube]  
Nitro Kid is a roguelike deckbuilder set in the neon ‘80s. Build your deck of cyber kung-fu moves, use card combos and fight through the floors of INFINITY tower. Featuring 30+ Synthwave tracks composed exclusively for the game.

There are claims that INFINITY is conducting underground experiments with children in its local facility, and you have been hired by an anonymous contractor to investigate them.

You play as a lone fighter whose mission is to battle through the megacorp tower and free other Elida’s KIDs that have been used as test subjects by INFINITY.

https://i.imgur.com/EVG34Ir.gif

Choose your kung fu style, build your deck, show your moves and fight through the floors of INFINITY megacorp.

https://i.imgur.com/fYPyjmX.gif

Use your deck to fight your enemies smartly and save the KIDs!

https://i.imgur.com/lpmFRhi.gif

Remember: Manage your kung fu decks and health efficiently, and you will most likely succeed, or not; but we definitely hope you do! ;)

https://i.imgur.com/j6AYASz.gif
